title: Updraft
description: An endless climb up crumbling platforms. Every bounce takes you higher. The only way to lose is to fall.

title: Comet
description: Survive an arena that keeps filling up. You trail fire behind you. Anything that touches it burns away, so every escape route is also a trap.

title: Number Crunch
description: Answers drift down the screen. Shoot the right one. A streak makes them harder, a few misses ease them back.

title: Keystroke
description: A race you win on accuracy, not speed. Every key is tracked. The end screen shows which ones cost you. Needs a physical keyboard.

title: Sinkhole
description: A climbing game upside down. Drop through gaps in the hazards. Something rises underneath, and hesitating is what kills you.

title: Circuit Racer
tagline: Four circuits. Three rivals. One line.
description: Top-down racing on four circuits against a field of three, with a slipstream to work for and split times to chase. Pick your track, your race length and how hard the rivals push. Your fastest lap is the score.

title: Ballast
tagline: Stack the hold. Keep her level.
description: Crates drop into a barge that is floating, not fixed. Where you put the weight tilts the hull, and a hull far enough over ships water and ends the voyage. Packing a row tight battens it down and it slides out of the bottom of the hold, so the stack is something you work off rather than something you clear. The crates are odd shapes and awkward sizes, and the heavy ones are heavy.

title: Ember
description: A patchwork balloon drifting up a gorge at dusk. One control: hold the burner and you rise, let go and you sink. Everything else is reading the gap in the rock ahead and committing early, because a balloon carries its momentum and cannot change its mind. Rock arches, crosswinds, and a gorge that narrows the higher you get.
